issuesAndResolution.issue: Visible historical replay only accepted 8/188 frames and took 236.365 wall seconds for 120 active-animation seconds
issuesAndResolution.evidence: Historical result preserved in dated task/windowed-replay-20261021/demo-result.json; matching APK and first eight landmark rows; 28 observed packet gaps above the 1.5-second lease
issuesAndResolution.resolution: Added primitive timing/control-gap diagnostics and deterministic safety checks. Root cause of broad slowdown remains unproven; no new emulator run.

issuesAndResolution.issue: An epoch/lease-invalid frame still incurred inference after decoding
issuesAndResolution.resolution: Check unchanged frame guard immediately after decode and retain final guard. Stale work is recycled and counted as skippedStaleInferences. This avoids wasted inference, without extending lease or claiming throughput recovery.

issuesAndResolution.issue: Old in-flight work could update replacement-round diagnostic counters
issuesAndResolution.resolution: Capture RunStats with the frame attempt and attribute discarded work to its original round.

issuesAndResolution.issue: Isolated worktree had no ignored dependencies/models, and initial full Python run could not bind loopback inside the filesystem sandbox
issuesAndResolution.resolution: Reuse explicit existing dependency/cache paths. Python executes modified worktree code with canonical pinned model resources under the existing OS external-network deny policy permitting loopback. Final full suite passes; no installs/downloads.

issuesAndResolution.issue: Some delegated tasks hit model-capacity errors and work was paused for SayGo QA
issuesAndResolution.resolution: Inspected and preserved partial work, completed with available agents/root, stopped review/test activity for requested pause, resumed only on parent authorization.

issuesAndResolution.issue: Generated synthetic CSV used CRLF, which the staged whitespace check flagged
issuesAndResolution.resolution: Normalized line endings to LF without changing numeric data, then reran the cross-language fixture verification and staged whitespace check.
